newsitem.title: UK: NatWest seeks to clarify strategy - FT.
newsitem.headline: NatWest seeks to clarify strategy - FT.

text.p: Lord Alexander, chairman of Britain's National Westminster Bank, has offered to meet the bank's 12 largest shareholders to clarify its strategy, the Financial Times newspaper said on Thursday.
NatWest shocked the markets this week with a profits warning and the departure of its investment banking boss Martin Owen.

The newspaper said Alexander had written to shareholders to to try to convince them that NatWest planned to refine its strategy for NatWest Markets rather than reversing earlier efforts to expand the operation.
